stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Stacey's Smart Team has been laid to rest (5.76 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🏟️ Game to watch: TB @ DAL (Thursday 8:15 PM), 10 league starters in action with 127.58 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (TB @ DAL): 10 league starters, led by Kirbo Crushers vs Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy.
🔁 Trade that should have happened: Price and Williams for Andrews and Adams back in Week 1 would have helped both TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace!.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Team Name leads the chopping-block odds at 25%, with Mel's Mediocre Mob next at 19%.
🔭 Player to watch: Dak Prescott (TB @ DAL). ESPN projects 18.02 pts, and 49er Faith-Fool is 53% against Mr. Action Jackson.
🎯 10 teams are in the thick of the median race, with Ruffing the Passer right on the line (48%).
🤝 Rivalry week: The Mahomies leads TDsMaGee 5–3 all-time, and The Mahomies has won the last 2.
🏆 Title odds entering Week 5: Brock You Like a Hurricane 33%, Gibb it to Me Baby 22%, Mr. Action Jackson 11%.
🥊 Waiver tug-of-war: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy beat Ruffing the Passer and The Mahomies to Will Shipley. Condolences to the rest.
🕰️ Hindsight swap: If Ramosverse and TDsMaGee had swapped Jake Ferguson for RJ Harvey back in Week 1, both would be ahead: +1 win each in optimal lineups.
⚔️ TDsMaGee vs The Mahomies is projected to finish just 2.50 pts apart.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 16% against The Mahomies — and won.
